purpose: Execution surfaces below Strategy. Agent Action remains semantic WHAT; Execution Surface Policy selects WHERE; Behavior Policy selects HOW naturally inside the selected variant.

page-cdp.notes: In-page pointer/keyboard/scroll/form/media execution through allowlisted CDP primitives.

browser-native.notes: Deterministic browser/tab/navigation control through CDP Page domain and browser control-plane APIs.

browser-ui-os.notes: Visible browser chrome / OS interaction through semantic UI Automation discovery and allowlisted physical Windows input.

selectionRule: Use the lowest/least-exclusive surface that can correctly satisfy the semantic action. BROWSER_UI_OS is an escalation surface, not the default for ordinary webpage interaction.
strategyBoundary: Strategy must not emit executionSurface, surface, executionVariant, mechanism, controlLease, HWND, screen coordinates, or raw protocol packets.

browserUiOsLease.rule: Acquire after explicit user consent and release on every terminal path. Only one physical desktop-input owner at a time per Windows desktop/session.
